title: Frigg Application Definition
description: Schema for defining a Frigg application configuration including integrations, infrastructure, security settings, and deployment options.

name.description: Service name for deployment (used as CloudFormation stack name prefix)

label.description: Human-readable display name for the application. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

region.description: AWS region. The deploy region comes from AWS_REGION (default us-east-1), not from this key. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

stage.description: Stage name used only to infer the KMS key alias. The deployed stage comes from `--stage`.

managementMode.description: Infrastructure management mode. 'managed': Frigg creates and owns the VPC, database and KMS key it needs (with vpcIsolation 'isolated', per stage). 'existing': use existing resources given by id. 'discover' (also the behaviour when omitted): find existing resources and create what is missing. 'custom' is accepted for compatibility and behaves like 'discover'.

vpcIsolation.description: With managementMode 'managed': 'isolated' gives each stage its own VPC, database and key; 'shared' reuses them across stages. Set it explicitly: when it is omitted the builders do not agree on a default (see ADR-051).

usePrismaLambdaLayer.description: Ship Prisma in a shared Lambda layer. false bundles Prisma into each function instead.

environment.description: Environment variable configuration. true includes the variable in the Lambda environment; 'ssm' offloads it to SSM Parameter Store (requires ssm.enable) so it never counts against the Lambda 4KB env limit

oneOf.description: Set to true to include this environment variable from process.env
Offload this variable to SSM Parameter Store; fetched at runtime instead of stored in the Lambda environment

integrations.description: The IntegrationBase subclasses this application exposes. JSON Schema cannot describe a JavaScript class, so validateAppDefinition checks a serialisable view in which each class is replaced by { Definition: <its static Definition> }; `frigg validate` checks each Definition structurally (name, version, modules and their API module definitions).

items.description: An integration class, seen as { Definition } (see the integrations description)

user.description: User management and authentication. Read by core when it loads the app definition; an omitted block gets the defaults below (ADR-051).

usePassword.description: Users log in with username and password (POST /user/login). false: users are identified by appUserId (x-frigg-appuserid) instead.

password.description: DEPRECATED alias of usePassword: when usePassword is not set, the loader copies this value into it.

primary.description: Primary user type. Any value other than 'organization' is treated as 'individual'.

individualUserRequired.description: Require an individual user. POST /user/login logs in individual users only when this is true.

organizationUserRequired.description: Require an organization user (looked up by appOrgId).

strictUserValidation.description: With x-frigg headers, reject a user id that does not exist instead of creating and linking it.

authModes.description: Authentication modes. When the block is omitted, Frigg tokens and the shared secret are accepted. x-frigg-appUserId and x-frigg-appOrgId headers identify the user with any mode.

friggToken.description: Accept Frigg bearer tokens from /user/login. Enabled unless false.

sharedSecret.description: Accept the x-frigg-api-key header (checked against FRIGG_API_KEY) for backend-to-backend calls. Enabled unless false.

adopterJwt.description: Accept JWTs from the adopter's own auth system (requires jwtConfig). Enabled only when true.

jwtConfig.description: JWT configuration for adopter JWT authentication mode (when authModes.adopterJwt is true)

secret.description: JWT secret key for signature validation (should be set via environment variable)

userIdClaim.description: JWT claim name containing the user ID

orgIdClaim.description: JWT claim name containing the organization ID

fields.description: Additional user fields. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

model.description: Custom user model class. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

auth.description: Authentication configuration. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

jwtSecret.description: JWT secret key (should be set via environment variable)

database.description: Database configuration for MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or DocumentDB

uri.description: Database connection URI (should be set via environment variable). Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.
MongoDB connection URI. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set. The connection string comes from DATABASE_URL.

tlsCAFile.description: Path to TLS CA certificate file for DocumentDB

enable.description: Use PostgreSQL. true provisions or discovers Aurora (unless management says otherwise). When omitted, Aurora is not provisioned, but migrations and the Prisma layer still include PostgreSQL; set false for a MongoDB/DocumentDB app.

management.description: How Frigg gets the Aurora cluster (ignored when managementMode is 'managed' or 'existing'). 'discover' (also when omitted): find one, else create one in the stack. 'managed': create it in the stack. 'use-existing': connect to `endpoint` without creating anything.

engineVersion.description: Aurora PostgreSQL engine version for a cluster Frigg creates

selfHeal.description: Automatically fix database configuration issues. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

publiclyAccessible.description: Make database publicly accessible (not recommended for production)

autoCreateCredentials.description: Create a Secrets Manager secret and rotate the Aurora password when a discovered cluster has none (management='discover' only)

clusterId.description: Only discover the Aurora cluster with this identifier

instanceId.description: Only discover the Aurora instance with this identifier

ownership.description: Per-resource ownership. When set, `management` is not translated.

cluster.description: Aurora cluster. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

instance.description: Aurora instance. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

subnetGroup.description: DB subnet group. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

secret.description: Secrets Manager credentials secret. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

dynamodb.description: DynamoDB access from inside the VPC

fieldLevelEncryptionMethod.description: Field-level encryption key. 'kms': Frigg creates or discovers a KMS key and sets KMS_KEY_ARN. 'aes': the app supplies AES_KEY_ID and AES_KEY (list both in `environment`). Omitted: no key is provisioned and deployed stages store sensitive fields unencrypted (core logs a warning). Stages dev, test and local never encrypt.

createResourceIfNoneFound.description: With 'kms' outside managementMode 'managed': create a KMS key when discovery finds none. When omitted, KMS_KEY_ARN falls back to the AWS_DISCOVERY_KMS_KEY_ID environment variable.

schema.description: Custom encryption schema defining additional fields to encrypt beyond core schema

fields.description: Array of field paths to encrypt (e.g., 'fieldName' or 'nested.field')

ownership.description: Per-resource ownership. When set, createResourceIfNoneFound is not translated.

key.description: KMS key. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

kmsKeyAlias.description: Create an alias for a KMS key Frigg creates

keyAlias.description: Only discover the KMS key with this alias

disable.description: Opt specific core-encrypted fields out of encryption: { Model: ['field.path'] }. Existing encrypted values still decrypt.

enable.description: Encryption is controlled by fieldLevelEncryptionMethod. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

vpc.description: Virtual Private Cloud settings for Lambda functions

enable.description: Run the Lambda functions in a VPC

management.description: How Frigg gets the VPC. 'discover' (also when omitted): find one (discovery fails if none exists). 'create-new': create VPC, security group and subnets in the stack. 'use-existing': use `vpcId` (and securityGroupIds / subnets.ids when given). Ignored when `ownership` is set.

cidrBlock.description: CIDR block for a VPC Frigg creates

securityGroupIds.description: Security group IDs for Lambda functions

management.description: 'create': create the subnets in the stack. 'use-existing': use `ids` (at least 2). 'discover', 'create-new' and 'existing' are accepted for compatibility but have no effect (`frigg validate` warns).

natGateway.description: NAT Gateway configuration for private subnets

management.description: 'createAndManage': reuse a well-placed NAT gateway or create one. 'discover', 'create-new' and 'existing' are accepted for compatibility but have no effect (`frigg validate` warns). Set `id` to use an existing NAT gateway.

id.description: Existing NAT Gateway ID (makes the NAT gateway external)

enableVPCEndpoints.description: Create VPC endpoints for AWS services (S3, DynamoDB, KMS, Secrets Manager). Enabled unless false.

selfHeal.description: Repair VPC configuration issues (route table associations) during discovery. When omitted, self-healing of stack-owned subnets is on.

shareAcrossStages.description: Legacy: true reuses (auto) the VPC and subnets across stages; false creates a VPC, subnets and NAT gateway per stage. Ignored when `ownership` is set.

ownership.description: Per-resource ownership. When set, management, subnets, natGateway, shareAcrossStages, enableVPCEndpoints and selfHeal are not translated; use `config` instead.

vpc.description: VPC. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

securityGroup.description: Lambda security group. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

subnets.description: Private subnets. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

natGateway.description: NAT gateway. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

vpcEndpoints.description: VPC endpoints. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

external.description: Ids of externally owned resources (ownership 'external'); discovered ids are used when omitted

vpcEndpointIds.description: Endpoint ids by type (s3, dynamodb, kms, secretsManager, sqs)

config.description: Settings for the ownership-based VPC configuration

cidrBlock.description: CIDR block for a VPC Frigg creates (wins over vpc.cidrBlock)

selfHeal.description: Recreate missing stack-owned subnets. Enabled unless false.

enable.description: Resolve a NAT gateway. Enabled unless false.

enableVpcEndpoints.description: Create VPC endpoints. Enabled unless false.

ssm.description: AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store configuration

enable.description: Enable SSM Parameter Store for configuration

parameterPrefix.description: Override the default parameter path prefix (/frigg/${service}/${stage}). Non-default prefixes may require widening the *frigg*-scoped deployment IAM policies

kmsKeyArn.description: Customer-managed KMS key for SecureString parameters. When set, the Lambda execution role is granted kms:Decrypt on this key. Defaults to the AWS-managed aws/ssm key

restrictIamToPrefix.description: Drop the legacy broad parameter/* read grant and only allow reads under the parameter prefix

tier.description: Parameter Store tier for this key: 'standard' caps the value at 4KB, 'advanced' at 8KB (billed by AWS)

secretsManager.description: AWS Secrets Manager configuration. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

enable.description: Enable AWS Secrets Manager for secure credential storage

scopedEnvironment.description: Scope framework-generated environment variables (queue URLs, migration/scheduler vars) to the functions that consume them instead of broadcasting to every function. Reduces per-function env size against the Lambda 4KB limit

keepNestedNodeModules.description: Keep nested node_modules in function packages (nested Frigg, AWS SDK and Prisma packages are still excluded)

routeSelectionExpression.description: Route selection expression for WebSocket. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

security.description: Security settings for the application. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.

webhooks.description: Webhook handling configuration. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set. Webhooks are declared per integration (Definition.webhooks).

logging.description: Logging configuration (ADR-048). An absent block changes nothing in the deployment.

level.description: Minimum log level, in lower or upper case. Sets FRIGG_LOG_LEVEL (when not info) and the Lambda application log level. When omitted, core logs at info and no Lambda log level is set.

retentionInDays.description: CloudWatch log retention for every Lambda log group, in days

format.description: Log format. Records are always JSON lines; this key is informational and has no default.

scheduler.description: EventBridge Scheduler resources for one-time jobs. Also enabled automatically when an integration declares webhooks.

enable.description: Provision the scheduler role and dead-letter queue

enabled.description: Force discovery on or off. When omitted, discovery runs when a feature needs it (VPC, KMS, SSM, PostgreSQL) and FRIGG_SKIP_AWS_DISCOVERY is not set.

failOnError.description: Fail the build when discovery fails

bucket.description: Migration S3 bucket. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

queue.description: Migration SQS queue. Who owns the resource: 'stack' (this stack creates it), 'external' (use the id in `external`), 'auto' (reuse what discovery finds, else create)

telemetry.description: Telemetry and usage tracking (ADR-011). An invalid block disables telemetry at runtime instead of failing.

exporter.description: Where traces and metrics go. When omitted: 'console' for STAGE=local, else 'none'.

traceExporter.description: A pre-built OTel trace exporter instance (advanced)

metricExporter.description: A pre-built OTel metric exporter instance (advanced)

northStar.description: The usage counter that measures each integration type's value: { default: { name }, byType: { <type>: { name } } }

subscribers.description: Telemetry event subscribers: functions or { handler } objects

adminScripts.description: Admin script classes (each with a static Definition). Validators see each class as { Definition }.

reports.description: Report classes (each with a static Definition). Validators see each class as { Definition }.

custom.description: Custom application-specific configuration. Not read by the Frigg runtime: it has no effect. Kept so existing definitions stay valid; `frigg validate` warns when it is set.
